lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to gills; features approximately 4-5 vertical columns with 3-5 spots each in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clear intersection of vertical high-intensity bands with lateral spot centroids, forming a stable 2D coordinate lattice across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from light (dorsal) to dark shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-luminance spots concentrated along its leading edge and distal tip.
